pr.title: fix(events): preserve unconfirmed end times during ingestion
pr.body:
Provider feeds currently invent a three-hour duration when an event has no confirmed end. Preserve an unknown end as NULL through Buen Plan, Ticketmaster and structured-feed normalization, persistence and replay. Keep cancellation authoritative over temporal inference.

Validation: isolated Stack/GHC 9.10.3 build with -Wall and all 26 EventDiscovery Hspec examples passed, including daily-slot properties and a database ingestion/replay regression for absent end times. The fixture schema now matches the existing nullable production column. Hosted checks and independent review remain required. No production event writes or publication approval.

Depends on #456. This narrow correction does not complete nationwide discovery, the shared pilot gate or video ingestion.
